_README: One-off adjustments to filed net income that THIS repo can cite. Written by the Deep dive when it reconciles a filing by hand; read by fetch-prices.js, which subtracts them from filed `ni` to build an 'own' recurring basis beside Yahoo's `norm`. Never replaces filed figures. Every entry needs fy (the fiscal year END date exactly as it appears in earnings.json), what it was, a source URL to the company's or regulator's own document, and EITHER `amount` (absolute, in the filing's currency) OR `amountPerShare` (converted using implied shares from the filer's own ni/eps). Positive means income to REMOVE. Use whichever form the source states.

TW.what: realised and unrealised gains on Canton Coin holdings, booked in Other income (loss), net — a non-operating line
TW.note: Company-stated PRE-TAX, and before the Up-C allocation to non-controlling interests, so subtracting it from filed attributable net income removes more than the after-tax effect — the store's stated bias toward looking expensive. The filed inputs for anyone wanting the after-tax figure are all in the same release: FY2025 effective tax rate 21.6%, consolidated net income $921.500m of which $812.792m attributable to Tradeweb Markets Inc. $205.4m of the $270.9m fell in Q4 2025 alone, which is why the TRAILING multiple is affected. Yahoo's norm for FY2025 is $812.792m, equal to filed attributable ni — the vendor removed nothing.

NVO.what: reversal of a US 340B Drug Pricing Program sales rebate provision (USD 4.2bn), booked in Q1 2026 as a reduction of cost of goods sold and an increase in reported net sales; non-cash, and excluded by the company from its own adjusted figures
NVO.note: Pre-tax, per the same convention as the TW entry; Novo guides a 21–23% effective rate for 2026. FY2026 is not yet a filed year in earnings.json, so this entry matches no row and is inert until the FY2026 accounts land — recorded now so the reconciliation is not thrown away again. Yahoo's norm for the Q1 2026 quarter equals filed ni exactly, so the vendor removed nothing. Going the other way in the same year, unrecorded here because the store only holds income to remove: DKK 6.3bn of non-cash pipeline impairments in Q2 2026, DKK 4.0bn of it monlunabant.

MWA.what: one-time tax benefit from recognition of a loss on a foreign subsidiary investment, in the fiscal 2026 third quarter
MWA.note: Company's words: "The decrease in effective tax rate was primarily attributable to a one-time tax benefit resulting from the recognition of a loss on a foreign subsidiary investment, benefiting adjusted net income per diluted share by $0.06." Fiscal 2026 ends 30 September 2026 and is not yet a filed year in earnings.json, so this entry matches no row until the FY2026 accounts land. Recorded on the fourth attempt: the 8 September proposal found it, had nowhere to put it, and every run since re-derived it. The release quantifies no separate tariff-refund amount — it names tariff refunds only as one of several drivers of higher pricing — so no second entry is writable from it.

LULU.note: Yahoo's norm for this year equals filed ni exactly, so the vendor removed nothing.
